Ladd is equipped with a mechanical arm featuring a grappling gun, allowing him to pull himself forward or swing from the ceiling.

Switch:walking-dead-final-season.d: The Walking Dead: The Final Season is a 2018 episodic graphic adventure video game developed by Telltale Games and later Skybound Games, and the fourth and final main installment in Telltale's The Walking Dead video game series, based on the comic book series of the same name. It consists of four episodes released between August 2018 and March 2019. Taking place some years after The Walking Dead: A New Frontier, the game focuses on Clementine's efforts to raise young Alvin Jr. (AJ) in the post-apocalyptic world, coming to join with a group of troubled teenagers surviving out of their former boarding school.

The game is set in a series of pinball machine-like environments with Sonic acting as the pinball.

Amiga:wonderland.d: Wonderland, is an interactive fiction game developed by Magnetic Scrolls based on Lewis Carroll's Alice in Wonderland.
